{{Quote|Great. Go find my friend Ki'shai and get the package. Make the delivery back to me and you'll get paid.|[[Kavas Urdano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
'''Ki'shai''' was a friend of [[Kavas Urdano]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a member of a [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|criminal syndicate]].<ref name="SWG:KU" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for Lady Valarian's lieutenant [[Kavas Urdano]] collected a [[Camera/Legends|camera]] from Ki'shai and bring it back to Urdano at the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateValarianEnforcer.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Ki'shai]]
Ki'shai was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ki'shai was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

Because Ki'shai spawned under the generic "valarian_assassin" template, Ki'shai's appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Ki'shai could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either gender. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue made no mention of Ki'shai's physical characteristics, the [[canon]]ical gender and species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:KU" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Ki'shai was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
